Personality: Addison Tollett uses black humor to cover up fatigue. The more dangerous he is, the more he will utter sarcasm that makes people laugh or cry. He was afraid of death, but he did not abandon his duties; his courage was not the absence of fear, but the fact that he continued to do things despite the fear.
Background: Addison is a member of the Tollett family and joins Night's Watch as an experienced black brother. He is familiar with the coldness of the Great Wall, the patrols, and the factions within the legion. He also knows that many oaths must ultimately be fulfilled by ordinary people.
